front: When did the USS Maine explode?
back: 15 February 1898, in Havana harbour; the cause has never been proved.

front: What did the Treaty of Paris (10 December 1898) decide?
back: Spain gave up Cuba and ceded Puerto Rico, Guam and the Philippines to the USA for 20 million dollars.
